verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is a U.S. immigration service, so origin-country guidance is a fair question to ask of it. Its published resources are organized by visa status or pathway (F-1 to O-1, J-1 to O-1, O-1 vs EB-1, startup founders). Nothing in the evidence covers consulate processing, per-country backlogs, or pages for founders from specific countries. The J-1 home-residency note is generic visa-category guidance, not country-specific content.

support.subject: As a founder abroad, the provider publishes origin-country-specific guidance — consulate processing, country backlogs, or dedicated pages for founders from my country
